alert.title: Reentrancy Attack Prevented on Protected Vault
alert.observation: VulnerableVault balance was fully drained from 5000000000000000000 to 0 wei (delta -5000000000000000000 wei). ProtectedVault balance remained intact at 5000000000000000000 wei after blocking the attacker's re-entrant call. Normal user deposit and withdrawal succeeded with exact accounting balance.
alert.hypothesis: Checks-Effects-Interactions (CEI) state reordering zeroed the caller balance before external ETH transfer, causing the re-entrant call's require(balance > 0) guard to revert and thwart exploit execution.
alert.suggested_action: Verify CEI across all asset transfer routines and consider OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard for defense in depth.
